description: Foresight is overwhelmed by crisis response short-term pressure and institutional fragmentation.
AI supports scanning simulation and scenario generation but requires strong governance and audit.
Indicators appear useful but lack interpretation thresholds or governance protocols.
Workshops and trend decks signal sophistication but do not alter decisions.
Multiple institutions coordinate across climate technology finance migration and public health systems.
Affected communities youth workers and publics shape scenario design and strategy choices.
Foresight is embedded in governance data systems strategy review and institutional learning.
Foresight integrates future generations ecological limits participation repair and accountability.
